configuration.host: Local browser file URI; portable standard HTML/JavaScript/CSS
configuration.clock: Explicit integer synthetic action steps; initial 0, maximum 80; no timer, wall clock or random input

behavioralRed.interpretation: Fixture/module load passed. Actual behavior assertions failed against a no-op implementation; not a missing module, parser error or manufactured failure.

inputGuardRed.interpretation: Actual inherited-field joined-key collision, symbol-field and nonenumerable-field regressions failed before replacing the key guard with exact own-key validation.

iac.reason: A resource-free local HTML/JS/CSS training bundle. No IaC, cloud resources, identity registrations, management operations or spending are needed or authorized.

green.scope: 40 pure-model behavior checks and 8 static bundle-contract checks, not a DOM fixture and not browser evidence

integrity.scope: Owned relative references, seven provenance hashes, exact raw TAP archives, both red reproductions, worked trace, actual browser artifact consistency, syntax records, JSON/whitespace and honest acceptance limits. This validator did not simulate a browser.

browser.pointerLimit: Prior ordinary pointer actionability attempts timed out on the earlier shared foreground page and are not counted. Required behavior was verified with trusted native keyboard actions.
browser.resetFix: Actual visible-page red exposed reset-event microtask ordering. The fixture selection is now restored before synchronous rendering, without replacing native reset or submit methods.

expectedAssertions: Unsynchronized and dual-owner transfers block without tenant effects.
Only the selected tenant changes route and exclusive ownership; its fence advances once.
The old captured source fence cannot produce post-handoff work.
Intention, configured routing, observed synthetic requests and site-attributed effects are separate.
Other tenants' complete model snapshots remain intact; a drift proposal is rejected, not applied.
Unsupported input fails closed; Reset restores the initial in-memory fixture.

workedTrace.result: Unsynchronized, stale-fence and unrelated-tenant proposals block; one target write and one target job; unrelated complete model snapshots unchanged.

rawTapPreservation.format: gzip of exact original TAP bytes, with original and presentation SHA-256 values
rawTapPreservation.presentationNormalization: Only trailing spaces/tabs are removed from .txt copies to pass the shared publication whitespace check. Actual failure diagnostics, counts and outcomes remain unchanged; gzip archives preserve every original byte.

userImpact.positive: A selected synthetic tenant moves after synchronization; subsequent synthetic requests and one write/job are attributed only to target.
userImpact.negative: Unsafe attempts are safe aborts before new effects, not successful uninterrupted migrations.

cleanup.reset: Six trusted native keyboard Resets restored selected cedar, heading, all tenant rows, observations, effects, clock 0 and empty trace in the actual browser.
cleanup.persistence: In-memory only; reload or Reset discards the synthetic run.

publication.method: Required scoped shared publisher; exact commit and annotated tag recorded in the worker final report after publication.
publication.resolution: This file is part of the implementation changeset. The required shared publisher and worker final result record its exact commit and annotated tag after Git creates them; no pre-publication hash is guessed.

limits: Synthetic local memory only; no actual database, Azure, management or background-worker operation.
Single-process atomicity and fence tokens are teaching models, not distributed ownership or a database replication protocol.
No native routing, latency, transaction isolation, durability, authentication, interruption rate or availability proof.
The unsafe dual-owner fixture intentionally violates selected-tenant ownership; operational attempts must block until Reset.
The unrelated-route fault is only a rejected candidate snapshot; actual unrelated tenant state remains intact.
Node behavioral/static checks are not a real browser; incomplete browser attempts are preserved and do not satisfy the browser gate.
At most 80 synthetic steps/trace entries per rehearsal; Reset/reload discards state.
Production runtime/auth design approval is not resource, IaC, identity-registration, cloud-execution or spending permission.
This is only A-S005. B-S005 and D-S005 parent/native acceptance remain separate; no bonus credit for tests, evidence or recovery.
